publication.label: Rodriguez-Almazan et al., human TIM E104D study (2008)

candidates.locator: Abstract, description of the mutant interfacial water network

value.description: E104D in the paper's numbering perturbs the interfacial water network and weakens contacts between subunits.

candidates.locator: Abstract, purified recombinant mutant compared with wild type

value.text: The purified recombinant E104D mutant retains catalytic activity but forms active dimers less readily, has reduced thermal stability, and monomerizes under conditions where wild type remains dimeric.

candidates.locator: Abstract, conserved buried water network between the subunits

value.text: A conserved buried water network bridges the subunits; the E104D mutant weakens and reduces interactions within that network.
